headline: 10 contracts catalogued on Scroll; Optimism migration in progress with addresses pending official documentation

findings.text: Official deployed contracts documentation found at https://etherfi.gitbook.io/etherfi/contracts-and-integrations/deployed-contracts listing 10 Cash-related contracts on Scroll with named roles.
No audit PDFs linked in protocol.audit_links (empty); audit discovery deferred.
GitHub repository identified (etherfi-protocol/cash-contracts) but specific deployment artifacts (broadcast/, deployments/) not yet fetched; commit SHA not pinned.

D5-Scroll: 10 addresses surfaced from official deployed contracts page. D5-Optimism: Recent migration announced Feb 2026 but contract addresses not yet listed in official documentation; pre-migration addresses on Scroll remain current.

Contracts classified with roles: factory (User Safe Factory), manager (Debt Manager, Price Provider), dispatcher (Settlement Dispatcher, Cashback Dispatcher), lens/provider (User Safe Lens, Cash Data Provider), and supporting contracts. Actor class not yet determined (pending bytecode inspection).

rationale.verdict: Discovered 10 contracts catalogued from the official EtherFi deployed contracts documentation for Scroll. The protocol recently announced migration to Optimism (Feb 2026) but new contract addresses for the borrowing market on Optimism are not yet available in official documentation or block explorer tagging. Further investigation needed for Optimism deployment and GitHub-sourced deployment artifacts.

evidence.shows: Official deployed contracts page listing 10 Cash contracts on Scroll with addresses and roles; cross-chain weETH deployments for both Scroll and Optimism; no borrowing-market-specific contracts yet listed for Optimism.
GitHub repository for ether.fi cash product; describes main components including UserSafe, L2DebtManager, PriceProvider; confirms borrowing/lending architecture.
Announcement of EtherFi's migration from Scroll to Optimism completed/in-progress as of Feb 2026, moving 70,000+ active cards and ~$160M TVL; frames as long-term partnership.

protocol_metadata.about: EtherFi Borrowing Market is a neobanking platform that enables users to borrow against cryptographic assets through vault-based smart contracts. The protocol features modules for user asset management, debt tracking, and price feeds, deployed initially on Scroll and recently migrating to Optimism. Users access lending and borrowing via the ether.fi Cash product, which integrates with DeFi protocols like Aave and Uniswap for collateral and debt management.
